antivirus_sweep.name: Antivirus Sweep
antivirus_sweep.description: Periodic node-wide damage scan that erases unshielded programs.
antivirus_sweep.explanation: Anti-virus sweep flags anything that doesn't match corporate whitelist. Unshielded programs get deleted instant.
antivirus_sweep.mitigation: Cloak III activates evasion, Shield absorbs first hit

trace_route.name: Trace Route
trace_route.description: Spawns trace ICE if runner stays in one node too long. The longer you hover, the more it learns about you.
trace_route.explanation: Matrix packets degrade with distance. A trace route rebuilds the path from the runner's jack. The trace becomes the path, the path becomes the ICE.
trace_route.mitigation: Move to new node resets timer, Stealth III breaks active trace

data_corruption.name: Data Corruption
data_corruption.description: Reduces program effectiveness by 30% for 3 turns. Running corrupted programs feels like running through mud.
data_corruption.explanation: Data rots from the inside out. The Hosaka test was the first time they saw it happen in real-time. Now half the Sprawl runs on rotten data and nobody fixes it.
data_corruption.mitigation: Decrypt III cleans corrupted state, moving to fresh node resets

system_lag.name: System Lag
system_lag.description: Slows player actions by 50% for 2 turns. Every command takes twice as long to execute.
system_lag.explanation: Bandwidth is finite. The more you stack into a node, the more they fight over the pipe. Sometimes the fight gets ugly.
system_lag.mitigation: Boost III bypasses lag, moving to high-bandwidth node resets

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.description: Temporary node lockout for 2 turns. Cannot access node data, programs, or exits during blackout.
blackout.explanation: The matrix has weather. Sometimes the weather is a blackout. Sometimes the blackout is a message. Sometimes the message is shutdown.
blackout.mitigation: Antivirus protocol after 2 turns, Decrypt III breaks lockout
